title: Stock & deliveries
previousSlot: Carried over = the end count of {{slot}}
noPrevious: Some items have no end count from the previous shift. Please count the stock now first.

history.title: Change history
history.empty: Nothing recorded for this shift yet.

action.out: 📤 Record items sent to another store

form.inHelp: Enter only the items you received. Always count the contents yourself, even if the supplier tells you the number.
form.outHelp: Enter only the items you gave to another store.
form.openHelp: Enter the real count only for the items that do not match. Other items keep the previous shift’s count.
form.closeHelp: At the end of the shift, count what is left and fill in every item (0 if none). Usage is calculated automatically.
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. name of the person who brought it
form.noteOtherPlaceholder: e.g. Mr./Ms. … at the main store
form.noteRequired: For “other”, please write where it went.
form.enterAll: Enter a number for every item (0 if none).
form.negative: Some items have negative usage. Please count again.
form.unknownOpening: Usage cannot be calculated for items without a carry-over.
form.dateRange: You can record only yesterday’s, today’s or tomorrow’s shifts.
form.lossHelp: Enter only the items thrown away or damaged, and choose the reason. Add a photo if you have one.
form.photoHint: Photos / videos are optional (never film customers’ faces).

temp.title: Fridge temperature
temp.help: Facing the fridges, enter from the left.
temp.enterAll: Enter the temperature of every fridge (e.g. 3, -18).

hint.momo: Chashu: 1 tray = 1 bag. Cooked meat: 3 pieces = 1 bag.
hint.moyashi: Even if the supplier tells you the number, always count the contents again.
